# Notebook 50 -- Quantile mapping for the SSP projection series

**What this notebook does.** The SSP twin of `QED_20_qm_fit_apply.Rmd`
(which stays untouched). Per model x SSP x catchment x variable:

1. **Fit** seasonal EQM with the historical pair as training data:
   source = the model's **historical** catchment-mean aggregate
   (`agg_<var>_<model>.csv` from QED_05), reference = observed CAMELS-IND
   catchment-mean forcings, overlap = the full historical window
   1981--2014. Fitting on the full historical (not the ranking split) is the
   pre-registered projection-application choice (18 Nov 2026, header of
   `QED_40_ssp_aggregate.Rmd`): the out-of-sample fit/score discipline
   belongs to model *ranking*, not to projection *application*.
2. **Apply** each fitted mapping to the SSP aggregate
   (`data_processed/ssp/agg_<var>_<model>_<ssp>.csv` from QED_40, covering
   the three windows 2015--2040 / 2041--2060 / 2081--2100; the 2061--2080
   gap is source-NA by design and surfaces as `method_flag = "source_nan"`).
3. **Tail policy (pre-registered):** `pr` extrapolation is **"linear"**
   (constant clamping would truncate intensified future rainfall extremes);
   temperature stays "linear" as in the historical leg. This overrides
   `qed_extrap_pr <- "constant"` from QED_00 **for this notebook only** --
   every extrapolated value is still flagged, so downstream users can
   filter or downweight them.

   **Dated fix (2026-11-23, v2).** The `linear` branch of QED_00's
   `qed_apply_eqm()` extends *both* tails with the slope of the lowest CDF
   interval; for `pr` that interval is a drizzle artefact and the derived
   slope (~1e8) blew the high tail up to **4.0e9 mm/day** (CanESM5 / ssp245 /
   03008). Section 0b installs a per-tail applier for `pr` only. Its first
   version (per-tail slope from the outermost CDF segment) still peaked at
   8,588 mm/d because that segment is itself numerically degenerate; the
   final version uses a **robust OLS slope over the top 5 CDF points** and a
   **physical ceiling of 1,000 mm/d on extrapolated pr**, with the capped-day
   count logged. Temperature is left exactly as in the historical leg. After
   the fix the same CanESM5 series has max 151.9 mm/d for its own extremes;
   the ceiling binds only on the most extreme source storms. The verification
   chunk fails the run if any corrected `pr` exceeds 1000 mm/d.
4. **No silent drops:** every skip is a summary row AND a log line; flags
   (`within_range`, `extrapolated_low/high`, `source_nan`) propagate to
   `method_flag` in every output CSV exactly as in the historical leg.
5. **Tail policy is also a factor in H4, not only a setting.** The
   decomposition (GCM x structure x tail policy) needs a second level, so the
   policy can be overridden *for that experiment only*:

   ```
   QED_SSP_TAIL=constant Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('QED_50_ssp_apply.Rmd')"
   ```

   The default stays `linear`; every projection the paper reports comes from
   the linear run. Outputs are policy-scoped (below) so the two levels cannot
   overwrite each other, and the override never substitutes for the
   pre-registered policy.

Output layout (inside `data_processed/ssp/`, `<tag>` = `_linear` or `_constant`):

```
qm_corrected<tag>/<model>/<ssp>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.csv   # date, source_value, corrected_value, method_flag
qm_params<tag>/<model>/<tier>/<catchment_id>_<var>.rds            # fitted quantile pairs (per historical fit)
qed_50_run_summary<tag>.csv                                       # one row per model x ssp x catchment x var
```

```{r log-file}
qed_ssp_dir <- file.path(qed_project_root, "data_processed", "ssp")
# The tail policy is read here (not only in section 0) so the LOG FILE is
# policy-scoped too: the linear and constant runs must not interleave.
qed_extrap_pr <- Sys.getenv("QED_SSP_TAIL", "linear")
stopifnot(qed_extrap_pr %in% c("linear", "constant"))
qed_ssp_tag <- paste0("_", qed_extrap_pr)
qed_ssp_log_file <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, paste0("qed_50_log", qed_ssp_tag, ".txt"))
stopifnot(dir.exists(qed_ssp_dir))   # QED_40 must have produced the SSP aggs
```

## 0. Tail-policy override (pre-registered, dated)

```{r tail-policy}
# Pre-registered in QED_40_ssp_aggregate.Rmd (18 Nov 2026): SSP pr tail = linear.
# qed_extrap_pr / qed_ssp_tag are read in the log-file chunk above so the log
# file is policy-scoped; the environment override exists ONLY to build the
# second level of H4's tail-policy factor (note 5 above) and is never used for
# a reported projection.
cat("pr tail policy for the SSP leg:", qed_extrap_pr,
    "(historical leg used 'constant' -- deliberate, dated override)\n")

# Policy-scoped output names: the linear and constant runs cannot collide.
qed_ssp_corr_dir   <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, paste0("qm_corrected", qed_ssp_tag))
qed_ssp_par_root   <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir, paste0("qm_params",    qed_ssp_tag))
qed_ssp_summary_fp <- file.path(qed_ssp_dir,
                                paste0("qed_50_run_summary", qed_ssp_tag, ".csv"))
cat("output tree:", qed_ssp_corr_dir, "\n")
```

### 0b. Corrected linear high-tail slope for `pr` (dated fix, 2026-11-23)

```{r tail-fix}
# WHY THIS EXISTS. QED_00's qed_apply_eqm() extends BOTH tails with the slope
# of the LOWEST CDF interval:
#      slope <- (q_ref[2] - q_ref[1]) / (q_src[2] - q_src[1])
# For precipitation that interval is a drizzle artefact: for CanESM5 / 03008 /
# DJF, q_src = (0, 1.9e-10) mm/d against q_ref = (0, 0.05) mm/d, i.e. a slope
# of 2.6e8 where the true high-tail slope is 2.11. Applying it above the
# training maximum turned a 60.13 mm/d future storm into 4.0e9 mm/d
# (measured in qm_corrected_linear/CanESM5/ssp245/tier1/03008_pr.csv).
#
# The FIRST-ORDER INTENT of the pre-registered "linear" policy (QED_40,
# 18 Nov 2026) is per-tail linear extension; the single-slope code did not
# implement it. This applier is qed_apply_eqm() with the high tail using
# (a) a ROBUST slope and (b) a physical ceiling for pr:
#
#   (a) the outermost CDF segment alone is numerically degenerate: its two
#       top quantiles can be nearly identical in source space, so even the
#       per-tail slope explodes (measured after the first fix attempt: max
#       corrected pr still 8,588 mm/d). The high-tail slope is therefore an
#       OLS fit over the top 5 CDF points (cov/var form, no lm overhead).
#       Slope census over all 5,324 pr fits: median 2.67, p95 7.4, p99 14.4
#       -- the slope itself is legitimately large because GCM drizzle maps
#       onto intense observed storms.
#   (b) with source storms up to 8-15x the training maximum, ANY linear
#       extension yields unphysical values (implied corrected pr at a
#       600 mm/d source storm: median 1,580, p95 4,370). Extrapolated pr is
#       therefore capped at QED_SSP_PR_CEILING = 1000 mm/d -- about 8x the
#       observed reference maximum and below the world-record 24-h rainfall
#       (1,825 mm, Foc-Foc 1966). The cap binds only far beyond the mapped
#       range (the pre-registered intent "constant clamping would truncate
#       intensified future rainfall extremes" is preserved inside it) and
#       every capped day is counted and logged.
#
# It is used for pr ONLY: temperature keeps the exact historical-leg
# implementation, so the historical and SSP corrections remain identical for
# that variable (its low-interval slope is O(1), so the amplification there
# is modest and pre-existing).
qed_ssp_pr_ceiling <- 1000   # mm/d, physical ceiling on extrapolated pr

qed_ssp_apply_eqm <- function(x, fit, extrap = "constant", per_tail = FALSE,
                              ceiling = Inf) {
   out <- data.table::data.table(
      x_src = x, x_corrected = NA_real_,
      within_range = NA, extrapolated_low = FALSE, extrapolated_high = FALSE)
   if (is.null(fit)) return(out)

   na_i <- is.na(x)
   n    <- length(fit$q_src)
   lo   <- fit$q_src[1]
   hi   <- fit$q_src[n]

   p_x <- stats::approx(fit$q_src, fit$p, xout = x, method = "linear",
                        yleft = 0, yright = 1, rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y
   y   <- stats::approx(fit$p, fit$q_ref, xout = p_x, method = "linear",
                        rule = 2, ties = "ordered")$y

   low_i  <- !na_i & x < lo
   high_i <- !na_i & x > hi

   if (extrap == "linear" && any(low_i | high_i)) {
      dsx_lo <- fit$q_src[2] - fit$q_src[1]
      dry_lo <- fit$q_ref[2] - fit$q_ref[1]
      slope_lo <- if (is.finite(dsx_lo) && dsx_lo > 0) dry_lo / dsx_lo else 1
      if (isTRUE(per_tail)) {
         k   <- min(5L, n)
         pts <- seq.int(n - k + 1L, n)
         sx  <- fit$q_src[pts]
         sy  <- fit$q_ref[pts]
         slope_hi <- if (length(sx) > 1 && diff(range(sx)) > 1e-9)
                        stats::cov(sx, sy) / stats::var(sx) else NA_real_
         if (!is.finite(slope_hi) || slope_hi <= 0) slope_hi <- NA_real_
      } else {
         dsx_hi <- fit$q_src[n] - fit$q_src[n - 1]
         dry_hi <- fit$q_ref[n] - fit$q_ref[n - 1]
         slope_hi <- if (is.finite(dsx_hi) && dsx_hi > 0) dry_hi / dsx_hi else 1
      }
      y[low_i]  <- fit$q_ref[1] + (x[low_i]  - lo) * slope_lo
      if (is.finite(slope_hi)) {
         y[high_i] <- fit$q_ref[n] + (x[high_i] - hi) * slope_hi
         y[high_i] <- pmin(y[high_i], ceiling)
      } else {
         y[high_i] <- fit$q_ref[n]          # degenerate segment -> clamp
      }
   } else {
      y[low_i]  <- fit$q_ref[1]
      y[high_i] <- fit$q_ref[n]
   }

   out$x_corrected      <- y
   out$within_range     <- !na_i & !low_i & !high_i
   out$extrapolated_low  <- low_i
   out$extrapolated_high <- high_i
   out
}

qed_ssp_pr_per_tail <- TRUE   # pr high tail uses its own robust slope (see above)
qed50_pr_capped <- 0L         # counts corrected pr days at the physical ceiling
qed_log(paste("tail fix v2:", if (qed_ssp_pr_per_tail) "pr high tail uses the" else
              "pr high tail reuses the",
              "high-interval slope; robust OLS over the top 5 CDF points;",
              "extrapolated pr capped at", qed_ssp_pr_ceiling, "mm/d"),
        qed_ssp_log_file)
```

## 1. Inputs: roster + historical aggs + SSP aggs

```{r load-inventory}
inventory <- data.table::fread(file.path(qed_output_dir, "inventory.csv"),
                               colClasses = list(character = "id"))
qm_catch <- inventory[final_action %in%
                         c("tier1", "tier2", "correct_with_warning")]
qm_catch[, tier := data.table::fifelse(final_action == "tier1", "tier1", "tier2")]
cat("Catchments to correct:", nrow(qm_catch), "\n")
```

```{r model-ssp-discovery, eval=TRUE}
# discover (model, ssp) pairs from the QED_40 output names:
# agg_<var>_<model>_<ssp>.csv ; model names contain "-" but not "_"
files_ssp <- list.files(qed_ssp_dir, pattern =
                           "^agg_(pr|tasmax|tasmin)_.+_ssp[0-9]+\\.csv$")
rows <- lapply(seq_along(files_ssp), function(i) {
   p <- strsplit(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(files_ssp[i])), "_")[[1]]
   data.table::data.table(var = p[2],
                          model = paste(p[3:(length(p) - 1)], collapse = "_"),
                          ssp = p[length(p)], file = files_ssp[i])
})
meta <- data.table::rbindlist(rows, use.names = TRUE)
models_ssp <- sort(unique(meta$model))
ssps_all   <- sort(unique(meta$ssp))
cat("SSP agg files:", nrow(meta), "| models:", length(models_ssp),
    "| SSPs:", paste(ssps_all, collapse = ","), "\n")

# models must also have historical aggregates to fit on
hist_ok <- vapply(models_ssp, function(m) all(file.exists(
   file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_", qed_vars, "_", m, ".csv")))),
   logical(1))
if (any(!hist_ok)) {
   drop_m <- models_ssp[!hist_ok]
   qed_log(paste("SKIP models without full historical aggs:",
                 paste(drop_m, collapse = ", ")), qed_ssp_log_file)
   meta <- meta[!model %in% drop_m]
   models_ssp <- models_ssp[hist_ok]
}
cat("Models to correct:", length(models_ssp), "\n")
```

```{r test-mode-override}
# explicit, visible test mode (mirror of QED_20's): set QED_50_TEST=1 for a
# small run; production leaves it unset/0
qed50_test_mode <- identical(Sys.getenv("QED_50_TEST", "0"), "1")
if (qed50_test_mode) {
   models_ssp <- models_ssp[1]
   meta <- meta[model == models_ssp & ssp == ssps_all[1]]
   qm_catch <- head(qm_catch, 5)
   cat("TEST MODE: 1 model x 1 ssp x 5 catchments\n")
}
```

## 2. Cache the reference forcings (read once)

```{r cache-forcing}
forcing_cache <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(qm_catch)), qm_catch$id)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
   id <- qm_catch$id[i]
   f  <- qed_read_forcing(file.path(qed_forcing_dir, paste0(id, ".csv")))
   f  <- f[date >= qed_period_start & date <= qed_period_end]
   forcing_cache[[id]] <- f
}
```

## 3. Fit on the historical pair (once per model x catchment x var), then apply to every SSP

```{r main-loop, eval=TRUE}
dir.create(qed_ssp_corr_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(qed_ssp_par_root, showWarnings = FALSE)

summary_rows <- list(); n_row <- 0L
qed50_pr_max  <- 0          # tracks the largest corrected pr written (tail-fix check)
qed50_pr_gt500 <- 0L        # days above a physical daily ceiling (1000 mm/d is
                            # the world record; 500 mm/d is already extreme)

for (m in models_ssp) {

   # ---- historical aggs (fit sources) + observed reference -------------------
   agg_pr  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_pr_",    m, ".csv")))
   agg_tx  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmax_", m, ".csv")))
   agg_tn  <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_agg_dir, paste0("agg_tasmin_", m, ".csv")))
   hist_agg <- list(pr = agg_pr, tasmax = agg_tx, tasmin = agg_tn)

   # ---- fits: one per catchment x var, reused across all SSPs ----------------
   fits_cache <- setNames(vector("list", nrow(qm_catch)), qm_catch$id)
   for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
      id  <- qm_catch$id[i]
      tier <- qm_catch$tier[i]
      par_dir <- file.path(qed_ssp_par_root, m, tier)
      dir.create(par_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
      ref <- forcing_cache[[id]]
      fc <- list()
      for (var in qed_vars) {
         rcol <- qed_camels_var_cols[[var]]
         src_all  <- qed_get_series(hist_agg[[var]], id)
         src_date <- hist_agg[[var]]$dates
         in_win   <- src_date >= qed_period_start & src_date <= qed_period_end
         n_overlap_valid <- sum(!is.na(src_all[in_win]))
         if (n_overlap_valid < qed_min_days_for_qm) {
            fc[[var]] <- list(status = paste0("skipped_overlap_lt_",
                                              qed_min_days_for_qm),
                              n_overlap = n_overlap_valid)
            next
         }
         ref_w <- ref[[rcol]][ref$date %in% src_date[in_win]]
         fits  <- list(); bins_used <- character(0)
         s_lbl <- qed_date_to_season(src_date[in_win]); src_w <- src_all[in_win]
         for (s in names(qed_seasons)) {
            if (sum(s_lbl == s) >= qed_min_quantile_sample) {
               fits[[s]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w[s_lbl == s], ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
               if (!is.null(fits[[s]])) bins_used <- c(bins_used, s)
            }
         }
         if (length(bins_used) < length(qed_seasons)) {
            fits[["annual"]] <- qed_fit_eqm(src_w, ref_w, qed_n_quantiles)
            if (!is.null(fits[["annual"]]))
               bins_used <- c(bins_used, "annual(fallback)")
         }
         fc[[var]] <- list(status = if ("annual(fallback)" %in% bins_used)
                              "fitted_annual_fallback" else "fitted",
                           fits = fits, bins = paste(bins_used, collapse = "+"),
                           n_overlap = n_overlap_valid)
      }
      fits_cache[[id]] <- fc
   }

   # ---- apply to each SSP series --------------------------------------------
   ssps_here <- sort(unique(meta[model == m, ssp]))
   for (s in ssps_here) {
      ssp_files <- meta[model == m & ssp == s]
      ssp_agg <- setNames(vector("list", 3), qed_vars)
      for (v in qed_vars) {
         fp <- ssp_files[var == v, file]
         if (!length(fp)) { ssp_agg[[v]] <- NULL; next }
         ssp_agg[[v]] <- qed_read_agg(file.path(qed_ssp_dir, fp))
      }

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(qm_catch))) {
         id <- qm_catch$id[i]; tier <- qm_catch$tier[i]
         out_dir <- file.path(qed_ssp_corr_dir, m, s, tier)
         dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

         res <- tryCatch({
            for (var in qed_vars) {
               fc <- fits_cache[[id]][[var]]
               if (is.null(fc) || is.null(fc$fits)) {
                  summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                     m, ssp = s, id, var, tier,
                     status = if (is.null(fc)) "skipped_no_hist_fit"
                              else fc$status,
                     n_overlap = if (is.null(fc)) NA_integer_
                                 else fc$n_overlap,
                     n_extrap = NA_integer_,
                     frac_extrap = NA_real_)
                  next
               }
               if (is.null(ssp_agg[[var]])) {
                  summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                     m, ssp = s, id, var, tier, status = "skipped_ssp_agg_missing",
                     n_overlap = NA_integer_, n_extrap = NA_integer_,
                     frac_extrap = NA_real_)
                  next
               }
               src_all  <- qed_get_series(ssp_agg[[var]], id)
               src_date <- ssp_agg[[var]]$dates
               extrap <- switch(var, pr = qed_extrap_pr,
                                tasmax = qed_extrap_temp,
                                tasmin = qed_extrap_temp)

               appl <- data.table::data.table(
                  x_src = src_all, x_corrected = NA_real_,
                  within_range = NA, extrapolated_low = FALSE,
                  extrapolated_high = FALSE)
               s_full <- qed_date_to_season(src_date)
               for (sn in names(qed_seasons)) {
                  w <- which(s_full == sn)
                  if (!length(w)) next
                  f <- fc$fits[[sn]]
                  if (is.null(f)) f <- fc$fits[["annual"]]
                  if (is.null(f)) stop(sprintf(
                     "%s/%s/%s/%s: no fit for season %s and no annual fallback",
                     m, s, id, var, sn))
                  rr <- qed_ssp_apply_eqm(src_all[w], f, extrap,
                                          per_tail = identical(var, "pr") &&
                                             qed_ssp_pr_per_tail,
                                          ceiling = if (identical(var, "pr"))
                                             qed_ssp_pr_ceiling else Inf)
                  appl$x_corrected[w]       <- rr$x_corrected
                  appl$within_range[w]      <- rr$within_range
                  appl$extrapolated_low[w]  <- rr$extrapolated_low
                  appl$extrapolated_high[w] <- rr$extrapolated_high
               }

               method_flag <- ifelse(is.na(appl$x_src), "source_nan",
                              ifelse(appl$extrapolated_low, "extrapolated_low",
                               ifelse(appl$extrapolated_high,
                                      "extrapolated_high", "within_range")))

               bad <- sum(is.na(appl$x_corrected) & !is.na(appl$x_src))
               if (bad > 0) stop(sprintf(
                  "%s/%s/%s/%s: %d corrected NaN with valid source",
                  m, s, id, var, bad))

               out <- data.table::data.table(
                  date = src_date, source_value = appl$x_src,
                  corrected_value = appl$x_corrected,
                  method_flag = method_flag)
               data.table::fwrite(out,
                  file.path(out_dir, paste0(id, "_", var, ".csv")))

               if (var == "pr") {
                  qed50_pr_max   <- max(qed50_pr_max,
                                        max(out$corrected_value, na.rm = TRUE))
                  qed50_pr_gt500 <- qed50_pr_gt500 +
                     sum(out$corrected_value > 500, na.rm = TRUE)
                  qed50_pr_capped <- qed50_pr_capped +
                     sum(out$method_flag == "extrapolated_high" &
                            out$corrected_value >= qed_ssp_pr_ceiling,
                         na.rm = TRUE)
               }

               n_extrap <- sum(appl$extrapolated_low |
                                  appl$extrapolated_high)
               summary_rows[[n_row <- n_row + 1L]] <- data.frame(
                  m, ssp = s, id, var, tier, status = fc$status,
                  n_overlap = fc$n_overlap, n_extrap = n_extrap,
                  frac_extrap = round(n_extrap / length(src_date), 4))
            }
            "ok"
         }, error = function(e) {
            qed_log(paste("ERROR", m, s, id, conditionMessage(e)),
                    qed_ssp_log_file)
            paste("error:", conditionMessage(e))
         })
      }
      rm(ssp_agg); invisible(gc())
      qed_log(paste("ssp done:", m, s), qed_ssp_log_file)
   }

   rm(hist_agg, fits_cache, agg_pr, agg_tx, agg_tn); invisible(gc())
   qed_log(paste("model done:", m), qed_ssp_log_file)
}

qed50_summary <- data.table::rbindlist(summary_rows, fill = TRUE)
data.table::fwrite(qed50_summary, qed_ssp_summary_fp)
print(table(qed50_summary$status))
```

## 4. Verification

```{r verify}
made <- list.files(qed_ssp_corr_dir,
                   pattern = "_pr\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("catchment pr series written:", length(made), "\n")
stopifnot(length(made) > 0)   # never wipe outputs on a config mistake

# spot-check one output: flags + gap accounting
one <- data.table::fread(made[1])
print(one[, .N, by = method_flag])
cat("gap rule: 'source_nan' includes Feb-29 of noleap models AND the\n",
    "2061-2080 window gap -- downstream counts these in n_gap_filled,\n",
    "never fills silently.\n")

# tail-fix check: a corrected daily pr must stay physically plausible
cat(sprintf("max corrected pr written: %.2f mm/d | days > 500 mm/d: %d | days at the %g mm/d ceiling: %d\n",
            qed50_pr_max, qed50_pr_gt500, qed_ssp_pr_ceiling, qed50_pr_capped))
qed_log(sprintf("tail fix check: max corrected pr = %.2f mm/d, days > 500 = %d, days at ceiling = %d",
                qed50_pr_max, qed50_pr_gt500, qed50_pr_capped), qed_ssp_log_file)
if (qed50_pr_max > 1000) stop(
   "corrected pr exceeds 1000 mm/d -- tail extrapolation is still broken")

qed_log(paste("QED_50 done:", qed_extrap_pr, "tail,", length(made),
              "pr series"), qed_ssp_log_file)
```

**Handoff contract for downstream SSP modules:** corrected SSP series live at
`data_processed/ssp/qm_corrected_<tail>/<model>/<ssp>/<tier>/<id>_<var>.csv`
(`<tail>` = `linear` for every reported projection, `constant` only for the H4
tail-policy level) with the same columns as the historical `qm_corrected/`
tree, so the HYD-style readers work unchanged. NAs mean: window gap
(2061--2080), Feb-29 of noleap models, or 360-day-calendar invalid dates --
always count, never fill. `extrapolation_share` for SSP rows must be computed
on the SSP window days.
